blocks.html: For any use which is permitted in both such districts, the applicable requirements for accessory off-street parking and loading of that district in which more than 50 percent of the zoning lot is located shall apply to the entire zoning lot. The parking spaces or loading berths may be located anywhere on the zoning lot without regard to district boundaries, provided that such spaces or berths shall conform to all other applicable regulations of this Resolution.
